text: To some of the citizens enquiring, How shall we avoid the invasions of enemies, he replied, If you are poor, and one covets no more than another. And to others demanding why he did not wall his city he said, That city is not unwalled which is encompassed with men and not brick.
author: Plutarch
speaker: Lycurgus
locator: Laconic Apophthegms, Of Lycurgus the Lawgiver
